title.narrative: Malaria - South-Eastern Asia - Multicountry East Asia and Pacific RAI (01-Jan-2017-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Multicountry East Asia and Pacific RAI, Malaria, United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS)This program has the following goals: To contribute to the elimination of falciparum malaria in the Greater Mekong Sub region, and to prevent the emergence or spread of artemisinin resistance to new areas. The objectives of this program are: Objective Tier 1-1: To interrupt transmission of P. falciparum by universal coverage and usage of insecticide treated bed nets (either long-lasting nets or treated conventional nets) in all targeted areas.. Objective Tier 1-2: To provide universal access to quality diagnosis and treatment for static populations at health facilities (public and private) and through community malaria workers.. Objective Tier 1-3: To provide access to prevention, diagnosis and treatment for mobile and migrant populations.. Objective Tier 1-4: To halt marketing and sale of oral artemisinin monotherapies.. Objective Tier 1-5: To establish and operationalize a rigorous surveillance system linked to a focal response mechanism.. Objective Tier 2-1: To ensure high levels of usage and coverage of insecticide treated bed nets (either long-lasting nets or treated conventional nets) in all targeted areas.. Objective Tier 2-2: To provide universal access to quality diagnosis and treatment at health facilities (public and private) and through community malaria workers in targeted areas.. Objective Tier 2-3: To halt marketing and sale of oral artemisinin monotherapies.. Objective Tier 2-4: To closely monitor trends in malaria cases, to identify and take action to control outbreaks, and to undertake TES in sentinel sites.
